## Brand Strategy
- Positioning: "Acura is a premium performance brand."
- Tagline: "Precision Crafted Performance" (paired with logo).
- Campaign line: "Less Talk More Drive" (LTMD) -- typeset lockup provided in stacked and horizontal versions.
- Unified brand identity across print, digital, and broadcast.

## Logo
- Full Acura logo: wordmark + caliper symbol.
- Caliper symbol: represents "Precision Crafted Performance." Can be used standalone only for sibling brands (Acura Motorsports, AcuraLink, app/web icons) with Acura Marketing approval.
- Caliper must never be used in ways that recreate or could be mistaken for a new brand logo.
- Safe space: clearance = height of the "A" typography. Tagline positioned at half the height of the "A" below. Tagline extends the width of the logo.
- Digital banner exception: clear space can be reduced to 1/2 X when space is limited.
- Logo colors: black, white, and "Acura Gray" for specific executions.
- Logo can appear over approved brand colors, photography, video, and texture -- legibility is the rule.
- "Less Talk More Drive" lockup: pre-typeset, provided in EPS and PNG. Used for headlines, end treatments, graphics.

## Tone of Voice
- "Less Talk More Drive" -- action-oriented, confident, no-nonsense.
- Performance-focused, premium positioning.
- Direct, instructional guidelines language.

## Outliers
- "Less Talk More Drive" as a campaign line with its own lockup system is unusual -- blurs the line between brand guideline and campaign toolkit.
- The caliper symbol governance is notably strict: requires Marketing approval for any standalone use.
- 52 pages in 16:9 presentation format -- optimized for screen-based review.
- The fixed relationship between tagline and logo (half-A-height spacing, logo-width alignment) is precise without being rigid.

## Quality Score
**3/5** -- Practical, well-organized marketing guidelines with clear logo governance and useful real-world exceptions (digital banner spacing). The LTMD lockup system adds campaign-level utility. However, this reads more as a marketing operations guide than a deep brand identity system -- strategy, typography, and color sections are referenced but not captured in depth. Serviceable for day-to-day execution.
